dek: Set for 13 December 2026, this single-distance half marathon runs in Nakhon Phanom, a Mekong River commercial hub in Thailand's Isaan region facing Laos -- from the same Scenic Marathon organisers covered at their Krabi and Chiang Mai races elsewhere in this research.
verdict: Scenic Marathon Nakhon Phanom extends the same organisation's footprint -- already covered at Krabi's beach half marathon and Chiang Mai's botanical garden race in this research batch -- to a third, entirely different Thai landscape: Nakhon Phanom, a Mekong River commercial hub in the Isaan northeast, directly across from Thakhek, Laos. That range across beach, garden and river-border settings suggests a genuinely versatile multi-region operator. It's a single-distance (21.1K) event, and registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: A Mekong Commercial Centre Facing Laos
paragraphs: Nakhon Phanom is a city in northeastern Thailand's Isaan region, capital of the province of the same name, lying along the Mekong River directly opposite Thakhek, Laos. [2] It's a commercial centre linked by road to Udon Thani, Ubon Ratchathani and Laos, with its own airport offering scheduled domestic flights -- genuinely accessible despite its distance from Bangkok.
